title: From Linear to Non-Linear SVM: Exploring Higher Dimensional Spaces

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, and welcome back to the course on machine learning.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回到機器學習課程。

cues.en: Previously we talked about the support vector machine algorithm, and today we're going to talk about the kernel support vector machine algorithm and the intuition behind it.
cues.zh: 先前談過支援向量機演算法，今天要談核心支援向量機演算法，以及背後的直覺。

cues.en: So as you recall, in the support vector machine situation, we had a set of observations which belonged to different classes,
cues.zh: 記得在支援向量機的例子中，我們有一組屬於不同類別的觀測值，

cues.en: and the point was to find this decision boundary between them so that any future observations could be identified which class they fall into.
cues.zh: 重點是在它們之間找出決策邊界，讓未來的觀測值都能判定屬於哪一類。

cues.en: And in this case, we can see that there's a decision boundary, and the support vector machine algorithm tells us exactly how to find that boundary.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到有一條決策邊界，而支援向量機演算法會確切告訴我們如何找到它。

cues.en: But what happens when we cannot find a boundary?
cues.zh: 但如果找不到邊界呢？

cues.en: What happens in a situation like this, for example?
cues.zh: 例如這樣的情況會怎樣？

cues.en: What do we do here?
cues.zh: 這裡該怎麼做？

cues.en: We can't just draw a line through these points, right?
cues.zh: 不能直接在這些點之間畫一條直線，對吧？

cues.en: We can't just separate them with a straight line.
cues.zh: 無法用一條直線把它們分開。

cues.en: We can't separate them with a horizontal line.
cues.zh: 無法用水平線分開。

cues.en: We can't separate them with a vertical line.
cues.zh: 無法用垂直線分開。

cues.en: Whatever we try to do, we cannot separate these points in the same way that the support vector machine algorithm told us to.
cues.zh: 無論怎麼試，都無法依照支援向量機演算法教我們的方式分開這些點。

cues.en: And so what happens in this situation, and why does it happen?
cues.zh: 這時會怎樣，為什麼會這樣？

cues.en: Well, this happens because in this case the data is not linearly separable.
cues.zh: 因為這裡的資料並非線性可分。

cues.en: So here we've got the two examples side by side.
cues.zh: 把這兩個例子並排放在一起。

cues.en: On the left the linearly separable data, and on the right the non-linearly separable data.
cues.zh: 左邊是線性可分資料，右邊是非線性可分資料。

cues.en: And what the support vector machine algorithm does is it helps us find that decision boundary or correctly place that decision boundary.
cues.zh: 支援向量機演算法能幫我們找到決策邊界，或把決策邊界放在正確位置。

cues.en: But it does have an assumption.
cues.zh: 但它有一個假設。

cues.en: The assumption is that the data is linearly separable.
cues.zh: 假設資料是線性可分的。

cues.en: So basically it's saying that it is possible to place the decision boundary.
cues.zh: 基本上就是說，存在能放置決策邊界的位置。

cues.en: So the support vector machine algorithm helps us choose the optimal decision boundary out of the multiple decision boundaries that we can draw.
cues.zh: 所以支援向量機演算法是在多個可畫出的決策邊界中，幫我們選擇最佳的那一個。

cues.en: Whereas in the non-linearly separable case, we can't even draw one single decision boundary or linear decision boundary.
cues.zh: 但非線性可分的情況下，連一條決策邊界，或說線性決策邊界，都畫不出來。

cues.en: So, therefore, the support vector machine algorithm just won't work by definition.
cues.zh: 因此按照這個定義，支援向量機演算法就無法運作。

cues.en: And so what are we going to do?
cues.zh: 那該怎麼做？

cues.en: Well, and this is what this section is about.
cues.zh: 這就是本節的主題。

cues.en: This section is about coming up with an algorithm that will help us deal with situations like that where we have to extract this class when it is surrounded
cues.zh: 本節要提出一個演算法，處理這種某個類別被包圍、必須將它分離出來的情況，

cues.en: or in other situations where you can't just simply just draw a line.
cues.zh: 或其他無法單純畫直線處理的情況。

cues.en: And the way this section is structured, or the intuition tutorials of the section is first of all we're going to explore a method we just called going to higher dimensional space,
cues.zh: 本節的直覺教學安排如下：首先探索一種稱為進入更高維空間的方法，

cues.en: where we will learn how we can take this data set and add an extra dimension
cues.zh: 學習如何對這份資料集，在所處空間中增加一個維度，

cues.en: into our space that we're dealing with and make our data linearly separable.
cues.zh: 讓資料變成線性可分。

cues.en: So we'll have a look at a couple of those examples and then we will discuss the kernel trick, which allows us to do these things in a more computationally efficient way
cues.zh: 看過幾個例子後，再討論核心技巧，讓我們以更有效率的運算方式做到這些，

cues.en: without having to deal with multiple or higher dimensions.
cues.zh: 不必實際處理多維或更高維空間。

cues.en: And, finally, we'll talk about the different types of kernels that exist.
cues.zh: 最後再談現有的不同核心類型。

cues.en: So quite an interesting section ahead, and I can't wait to see you on the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 接下來很有意思，迫不及待要在下一堂見到你。

cues.en: Until then, happy analyzing.
cues.zh: 在此之前，分析愉快。
